title: Undergraduate Research Opportunities (Boston College)
description:
Boston College's university-wide hub for undergraduate research. Across the humanities, sciences, business, and education, students gain exposure to new methods and lead their own research projects, with funding pathways including Advanced Study Grants, Summer Fellowships, Conference Travel Grants, and Thesis Research Supplemental Grants, plus links to prestigious national fellowships.

title: Advanced Study Grants (Boston College)

eligibility.eligibility_text_raw: Faculty nomination in early spring; applications due mid-March (early April for thesis applicants).

description:
Boston College Advanced Study Grants (ASGs) fund student-designed summer skill-acquisition or research projects that dramatically advance a student's progress in their major, or provide research assistance for juniors completing a thesis or Scholar of the College project. Students are nominated by a faculty member at the start of the spring semester; applications (a three-page proposal, budget, transcript, and recommendation) are due in mid-March.

title: Schiller Institute for Integrated Science and Society (Boston College)
lab_or_program: Schiller Institute for Integrated Science and Society
description:
The Schiller Institute supports BC faculty, students, and staff conducting interdisciplinary research and scholarship through seed-grant funding, training, and events that connect people across disciplines, schools, and methods. It is home to Human-Centered Engineering and focuses on energy, health, and environment challenges — a hub for students seeking cross-disciplinary STEM research.

From the program page: Research Schiller Institute Grants for Faculty Global Observatory on Planetary Health Research The Schiller Institute is committed to supporting BC faculty, students, and staff in conducting interdisciplinary research and scholarship through seed grant funding, training, and events aimed at connecting individuals with similar interests across disciplines, schools, and research methodologies.
